description: Read what a brand's MARKET RADAR (set_competitor_watch) has found: each watched brand's new ads, the winners (ads past 30 days running, with a ready brief to make your own version), the trending formats and top posts for its topics, and the ideas to make, plus its state (lastRun, nextRunAt, lastRunOk, paused) and the quote for its next check. Findings marked `seed:true` are what a brand was already running at its first check, not new launches. Read-only and free; it never runs a check.

brand.description: profile id/name from list_brands, this call only

competitor.description: only this watched brand's ads (exact name as returned)

name: list_watch_findings
title: Read the market radar
